record.title: Recover exact TCP transcripts from preserved packet captures
record.intent: Replace repeated offline packet and byte-sequence logic with an explicit typed library boundary.
requirements: Add a typed reusable workspace library and delegated CLI for a bounded documented classic Ethernet IPv4 TCP capture profile with explicit endpoint selection and no network I/O.
Require unambiguous SYN origins and FIN extents; handle sequence wrap and consistent retransmissions; reject gaps conflicts truncation reset and unsupported selected-flow fragmentation.
Preserve raw request and response as library bytes; CLI reports counts and digests without exposing payloads by default; distinguish captured transcript from delivery or device execution.
Test meaningful synthetic positive and negative controls and compare a preserved private SCPI capture against original raw transcripts and legacy results without altering them.
acceptance: Typed gates and independent fixture and private transcript controls pass with limits documented.
